name: sb_write_sample
desc: Append an audio sample byte to the current Sound Blaster playback buffer
details: Appends an 8-bit PCM audio sample in AL into the active double buffer at CS:[DI+BX]. If the current buffer is full (0x600 bytes), calls sb_switch_and_flush_buffer (0823:100C) to initiate DMA playback and flip buffers. If an echo effect is enabled (CS:[13CCh] != 0), calls 0823:11F1 to process/mix echo before storing the sample. Returns far (retf).

params.name: sample
params.desc: 8-bit unsigned PCM audio sample to write

params.name: buf_base
params.desc: Base offset of active audio buffer within CS segment (0x001F or 0x061F)

0823:104a.comment: Check if echo/delay processing is enabled
0823:104a.label: buffer_ready

0823:1041.comment: Check if buffer is full (buffer size = 0x600 = 1536 bytes)

0823:1052.comment: Apply echo effect to sample in AL

0823:103c.comment: Load current byte count/offset in active buffer

0823:1047.comment: Buffer full: flush/play current buffer and swap to alternate buffer

0823:1055.comment: Store sample byte into active buffer at CS:[DI + BX]
0823:1055.label: store_sample
